description: Create a Stripe-hosted checkout link after the customer explicitly approves the exact plan, price, billing interval and quantity from dealmachine_plans. Requires confirmed=true. Never call for a declined or hypothetical purchase. Creating the link does not charge the customer or activate a subscription. The customer completes payment in Stripe (Link may be offered); then check dealmachine_account and dealmachine_usage. Never automatically retry checkout or collect card details in chat.
name: dealmachine_checkout
